message:
fix(update): closing is not refusing, and access denied is not death

Two places where "cannot tell" was quietly counted as "fine".

The relaunch decision read liveness once. The field log is unambiguous: at
18:56:20.266 the host acknowledged and was standing down, and nine milliseconds
later this read "still running", concluded there was nothing to bring back, and
skipped the relaunch. The host finished closing on its own and the machine was
left with nothing. Asked once, immediately, closing and refusing are the same
answer -- and everything in that list had just been asked to stop, so half of
"still running" is a normal in-progress close.

So a Running answer is re-asked for a bounded grace. Running the grace out is NOT
an exit: it stays Running and the relaunch is skipped for the reason it names,
which E10c asserts from the other side -- without it the wait could be read as
"wait and then assume". The default is zero so a test injecting a constant does
not pay a real timeout for it; production sets fifteen seconds.

request_process_stop counted a failed OpenProcess as "already gone, nothing to
ask". ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER means the pid is no longer a process, so there is
genuinely nothing to ask. ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED means we cannot look at it, and
calling that success lets the swap proceed over a process that may still hold the
files it is about to replace. The two are now different answers, and both
directions are asserted -- a really-exited pid and pid 4 used to give the same
result, which was the defect.

And the input service goes through the SCM. It has no window and no console, so
both mechanisms below it are inapplicable by construction, while it does have a
real supervisor. Not installed and already stopped are successes; unable to open
or control it is not.

64 suites, 1820 checks, no failures, console session attached. 1811 -> 1820 is
relaunch +7 and stop_process +2, which is exactly the new checks.

All seven items are now wired. Still unverified, and not claimed: a real host
taking this path end to end. The installed 0.2.108 updater does not contain any
of it, so a manual installer run is needed to bootstrap one that does.
